run.question: The payment-api pod in namespace app-259 had issues on November 20, 2026 around 13:45 UTC. What happened?

report.summary: The entity described in the question does not exist in the monitored cluster: namespace app-259 is absent and no pod named payment-api exists; the only payment workload is Deployment payment in namespace otel-demo (pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d). That pod is running and ready with 0 restarts, and its container has run continuously since 2026-11-20T16:33:03Z — i.e. after the reported 13:45 UTC incident time — so the cluster objects available here cannot describe the 13:45 state. Application logs retained for the pod (2026-11-21T03:12–03:45) show only successful charges, and checkout logged 'payment went through' up to 2026-11-21T03:45:30Z. The decisive sources for the incident window were not queryable: every Prometheus and Jaeger query returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and Loki returned no streams at all, and no Kubernetes events were returned for the authorized window. Consequently the reported 13:45 event on a payment-api pod cannot be confirmed, characterised or ruled out, and no root cause is named.

claims.text: The cluster's namespaces are default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly and otel-demo; there is no namespace named app-259.

In namespace otel-demo the only payment workload is the deployment payment (pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-payment, service account-less env FLAGD_HOST=flagd); no pod named payment-api appears among the 22 otel-demo pods.

payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d was created at 2026-11-20T16:32:07Z, its payment container started at 2026-11-20T16:33:03Z, phase Running, Ready True, restartCount 0 and lastState empty, so it shows no crash or restart while observed.

All 22 pods in otel-demo (including payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d) report start times between 2026-11-20T16:32:06Z and 2026-11-20T16:33:38Z with restart counts of 0, which is later than the reported 13:45 UTC incident time; the single payment ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 was also created at 2026-11-20T16:32:07Z.
The payment service is backed by exactly one ready endpoint, pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d at 10.244.0.18:8080, matching the Service payment selector opentelemetry.io/name=payment.

Retained payment container logs from 2026-11-21T03:12:27Z to 2026-11-21T03:45:30Z contain only info-level 'Charge request received.' and 'Transaction complete.' entries (e.g. transactionId 9fa35a0c-7cbb-46f0-a35e-803688c8adee), with no failure entry in the lines shown.

Checkout logs for 2026-11-20T16:33:00Z–2026-11-21T03:45:40Z include repeated info entries 'payment went through (transaction_id: …)', the newest at 2026-11-21T03:45:30.646Z matching payment transaction d67df732-75c4-4174-94b1-80725a3f690e.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (Helm release otel-demo, created 2026-11-20T16:32:06Z, resourceVersion 550) as read now sets all fault-injection flags to defaultVariant 'off', including paymentFailure (variants 100%/90%/75%/50%/25%/10%/off) and paymentUnreachable (on/off). The flagd deployment serves this file (--uri file:./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json from the config-ro mount of ConfigMap flagd-config).

The otel-collector container logged repeated failures between 2026-11-21T03:39:32Z and 2026-11-21T03:45:32Z ('failed to upload metrics: … rpc error: code = Unavailable … Addr: "10.96.247.55:4318", ServerName: "otel-collector:4318" … frame too large, note that the frame header looked like an HTTP/1.1 header'), and the prometheus-server container logged 'Error on ingesting out-of-order exemplars' warnings throughout 2026-11-21T03:30–03:45Z.
Deployments in otel-demo (including payment, flagd, prometheus and otel-collector) each show 1 desired replica, 1 available and 1 ready at the time of the query.

If the 13:45 UTC symptoms were charge failures on the payment service, the flagd fault-injection switches paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable are the mechanisms this environment provides for them; however both read 'off' at query time and I could not observe their value or any payment error/latency signal at 2026-11-20T13:45, so this remains unconfirmed and is not grounds for naming a cause.

The concurrent telemetry-pipeline defects (otel-collector repeatedly failing to export metrics to otel-collector:4318 / 10.96.247.55:4318 and Prometheus dropping out-of-order exemplars) may have degraded the completeness of metric and trace data; this is only correlation at 2026-11-21T03:30–03:45 and is not tied to the 2026-11-20T13:45 payment report.

Against describing the payment workload as currently broken: the payment pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, its Service has a ready endpoint, and both its own logs and checkout's logs show successful charges up to 2026-11-21T03:45:30Z. This describes only the post-16:32 observation period, not 2026-11-20T13:45.

Rejected as unsupported: a payment container crash/restart or OOM during the observed lifetime. There is no restart, lastState is empty, no previous container instance exists (the log tool reported no previous 'payment' container), and all 22 otel-demo pods report restartCount 0.

gaps: Prometheus was not queryable in this Run: get_metric_names, get_all_labels, get_series, metrics_range_query, execute_prometheus_instant_query, list_prometheus_rules and get_prometheus_target all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no series for traces_span_metrics_calls_total, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds, http_server_request_duration_seconds or kube_* could be read; missing series are unknown, not zero, and no error rate or latency trend at 2026-11-20T13:45 could be evaluated.

Jaeger was not queryable in this Run: traces_list_services, traces_search and traces_search_by_tags all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no payment or checkout spans from 2026-11-20T13:45 could be examined and no call chain is established.

Loki returned no streams for namespace otel-demo in any sampled window, including 2026-11-20T13:40–14:00Z and 2026-11-21T03:30–03:45Z, and a count_over_time over {namespace=~".+"} returned no series, so zero log lines is all that can be said about that source.

No Kubernetes events were returned for the whole authorized window across all namespaces (the events query returned no items), so no Evicted/OOMKilled/FailedScheduling/Unhealthy evidence is available; an empty result here is not proof nothing happened.

The reported incident time 2026-11-20T13:45Z precedes the creation of every object observed (pods and flagd-config from 2026-11-20T16:32Z onward), so the current Kubernetes state cannot describe the 13:45 state, and the pod/log retention (payment logs start at 2026-11-21T03:12:27Z) does not reach it.

The exact entity named in the report, pod payment-api in namespace app-259, does not exist in this target: no such namespace, pod or service was found, and the trace service list shows 'payment' (not 'payment-api'). The related but different entity is Deployment/payment in namespace otel-demo.

A query for payment container log lines matching error|fail|decline|refuse|unavailable|panic between 2026-11-20T16:33:00Z and 2026-11-21T03:45:40Z returned no matching lines (1979 lines read), and the same style of query on checkout for payment failure text also returned nothing; these empty results are unverified negatives, not proof of absence.

The history of the flagd-config fault switches (when paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable were last changed) is not observable: ConfigMap resourceVersion 550 carries no timestamp for data edits and the change_history integration is not available, so whether the flags were 'on' at 2026-11-20T13:45 is unknown.

It is unknown whether the Prometheus/Jaeger query path failure is caused by the running prometheus-readonly-proxy (its nginx container produced no readable log lines) or by the gateway itself; that tooling failure is a limitation of this investigation, not evidence about payment.
next_steps: Re-run the Prometheus and Jaeger queries for 2026-11-20T13:40–14:00Z (traces_span_metrics_calls_total by service_name/span_name/status_code for payment and checkout, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds, kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total) once the metrics/traces query path is reachable.

Check the prometheus-readonly-proxy configuration and the otel-collector exporter target (10.96.247.55:4318 / otel-collector:4318 self-reference shown in its error logs) to restore reliable metric and trace retrieval.

If a change history or audit source becomes available, review edits to ConfigMap flagd-config (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable) around 2026-11-20T13:45 to confirm or exclude a flag-injected payment fault.

Confirm with the reporter which cluster/namespace the 'payment-api' pod refers to, since namespace app-259 does not exist in this target; the analogous workload here is Deployment payment in otel-demo.
